This leaf is found chiefly in cool temperate climates, especially in tall grasslands, and is best known in north-western Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains easy to find.

Arlan provides two distinct remedies. Its leaves restore 4–9 concussion hits when applied as a poultice, or 1–6 when used without preparation; kept moist, they remain effective for one month. Its ground root, added to boiling water, releases decongestant vapours: inhaling them grants +20 to Resistance Rolls against colds and greatly speeds recovery from respiratory illness. The roots keep for up to a year.
